SELECT a.id, a.title, a.category_id, a.cover_url, a.summary, a.project_id, a.author_id, a.source, a.is_top, a.audit_status, a.view_count, a.publish_time, a.create_time, a.update_time, c.name AS categoryName, u.nickname AS authorName, p.project_name AS projectName FROM cms_article a LEFT JOIN cms_article_category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ich_project p ON p.id = a.project_id AND p.deleted = 0
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.*, c.name AS categoryName, u.nickname AS authorName, p.project_name AS projectName FROM cms_article a LEFT JOIN cms_article_category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ich_project p ON p.id = a.project_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
